'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a food item which restores {{Energy|+|15}} and applies the good fisherman buff when consumed. This item cannot be sold to anyone, its only use is to give you more energy/buff your fishing. Since the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].  Baked fish is also sold at [[The Dead Horse]] by [[Horadric]].

==Effect==
On use, baked fish will apply the good fisherman buff for a duration of 2 minutes, minimizing the chance of letting fish get off your hook. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
